 Cars, SUVs and pickup trucks recalled in Canada over fire risk, loss of power, faulty power seats and other potential safety problems
 Audi, BMW, Chevrolet, Dodge, Ford, GMC, Hyundai and Lincoln vehicle recalls were reported by Transport Canada between Oct. 26 and 30.
 By Metroland Staff Insidehaltoncom

 Saturday, October 31, 2026

 Various automakers recently issued recalls on cars, SUVs and pickup trucks in Canada.
 See below for the vehicle recalls that were reported by Transport Canada during the week of Oct. 26 to 30.
 Dodge
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Stellantis issued a recall on a new SUV from its Dodge brand — the 2026 Dodge Durango.
 It affects a little more than 1,000 vehicles.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 On certain vehicles, a connector on the taillamps could be damaged, causing the stop lamps, reverse lamps and/or rear turn signals to potentially not work.
 “Stop lamps, reverse lamps and/or turn signals that don’t work could cause a person not to recognize that a vehicle ahead is braking, backing up or intends to turn or change lanes. Taillamps that don’t work could make the vehicle less visible to others. These issues could increase the risk of a crash,” the recall, last updated Oct. 30, said.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 The automaker will notify owners in writing and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to inspect and, if necessary, replace the taillamp(s).
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW
 BMW
 BMW issued a recall that affects only 24 cars in Canada.
 The recall impacts:
 2018 to 2020 BMW 5 Series
 2018 and 2019 BMW 7 Series
 This recall affects certain vehicles repaired by a BMW dealer during Transport Canada recall No. 2026-332.
 The engine starter may not have been manufactured properly on some cars. The positive battery cable may not be secured properly to the starter and could become loose, which could cause electrical arcing (sparks).
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 “Electrical arcing could create the risk of a fire,” the recall, last updated Oct. 28, said.
 To reduce the safety risk, BMW advises owners not to use the remote start function and not to leave the vehicle unattended with the engine running until the recall repairs have been completed.
 BMW will notify owners by mail and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to inspect and, if necessary, replace the engine starter.
 Audi
 Volkswagen issued a recall on a vehicle from its luxury brand. It’s on the 2024 and 2025 Audi Q4 e-tron and affects both the Sportback and SUV body styles.
 Nearly 4,000 electric SUVs are affected.
 The high-voltage battery could overheat on some vehicles.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 “A battery that overheats can create a fire risk, even while the vehicle is parked and turned off,” the recall, last updated Oct. 28, said.
 To reduce the safety risk, Audi advises owners to set the maximum charge setting of their vehicle at 80 per cent until the recall repairs have been completed.
 Audi will notify owners by mail. The repairs for this recall are under development.
 Chevrolet, GMC
 General Motors issued a recall on a pair of SUVs from two of its brands.
 Affected vehicles include:
 2026 Chevrolet Traverse
 2026 GMC Acadia
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Just two vehicles are affected in Canada.
 The driver or front passenger seat may not have been manufactured properly on these two vehicles, and the seatback could move or detach in a crash.
 “A seatback that moves or detaches could increase the risk of injury in a crash,” the recall, last updated Oct. 28, said.
 GM will notify owners by mail and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to replace the driver or front passenger seatback frame.
 Hyundai
 Hyundai issued a recall on the 2026 Elantra. Just three cars are affected.
 The bolts that attach the front struts to the steering knuckles may not have been tightened properly on these few cars. This could cause the bolts to loosen or separate and cause a change in vehicle stability and/or a loss of steering control.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 “A loss of steering could create the risk of a crash. A change in vehicle stability could cause a loss of control and increase the risk of a crash,” the recall, last updated Oct. 26, said.
 Hyundai will notify owners in writing and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to inspect and, if necessary, tighten or replace the bolts on the front strut assemblies. A wheel alignment, as necessary, will also be conducted.
 Ford, Lincoln
 Ford issued several recalls lately affecting vehicles from its mainstream and luxury brands. We go over the Ford recalls one by one.
 Various Ford pickup truck models
 Ford issued a recall that affects multiple pickup truck models.
 Affected vehicles include:
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 2026 Ford F-150
 2026 Ford F-250 Super Duty
 2026 Ford F-350 Super Duty
 2026 Ford F-450 Super Duty
 2026 Ford F-550 Super Duty
 2026 Ford F-600
 Nearly 6,000 trucks are affected.
 The left-side tailgate cable may not have been manufactured properly on some vehicles, and, when under load, the cable could fail, causing the tailgate to drop suddenly.
 “A tailgate that drops suddenly could increase the risk of injury,” the recall, last updated Oct. 28, said.
 Ford will notify owners by mail and advise them to take their truck to a dealership to replace the left-side tailgate cable.
 Navigator
 Ford’s next recall is on the 2025 to 2027 Lincoln Navigator.
 More than 2,000 SUVs are affected.
 A problem with the rear audio control module (RACM) could cause the front passenger seat to unexpectedly move forward or backward, or tilt and recline on its own. The seat could also continue moving even if there’s an obstruction.
 “A seat that doesn’t stop moving could increase the risk of injury,” the recall, last updated Oct. 28, said.
 The automaker will notify owners by mail and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to update the RACM and accessory protocol image module (APIM) software to disable the chauffeur mode function.
 Corsair, Nautilus
 The third Ford recall is on a pair of Lincoln SUVs.
 Affected vehicles include:
 2027 Lincoln Corsair
 2026 and 2027 Lincoln Nautilus
 Only hybrid models are affected.
 More than 200 vehicles are affected.
 A problem in the integrated parking module (IPM) could cause the transmission to shift into neutral (N) unexpectedly on some vehicles, which could cause a sudden loss of power to the wheels.
 This problem would cause a wrench light and a “Service Vehicle Soon” or “Shifting System Error” message to appear in the instrument cluster display.
 “A loss of power to the wheels could increase the risk of a crash,” the recall, last updated Oct. 26, said.
 The automaker will notify owners by mail and advise them to take their vehicle to a dealership to replace the integrated parking module.
